## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Restarts the action list from the beginning if this action's condition evaluates to true. If it does not, execution continues with the next action. To prevent an infinite loop, a [Wait](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/wait) action must execute between the start of the action list and this action.

## Snippet
````
